title: Steampunk Fox in Wrecked Machine
description: A mechanical, cylindrical steampunk vehicle lies broken and rusted in a grassy field, its gears and pipes exposed. A small winged fox with butterfly wings sits atop the wreckage, looking toward a large red sun setting behind jagged purple mountains under a stormy sky.
prompt: A broken cylindrical steampunk machine covered in rust and exposed gears lies abandoned in a grassy field with scattered map pieces and flowers. A small fox with large butterfly wings sits on top of the wreckage. In the background, dramatic purple mountains under a dark cloudy sky with a giant glowing red sun on the horizon. A large red prohibition symbol floats broken in the sky. Surreal fantasy style, cinematic lighting, detailed textures.
